reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Truecica Natural Calming Tone-Up Suncream 50ml
reviews.text: I love this mineral sunscreens and you will too, here’s why. It’s the only mineral sunscreen I’ve tried thus far that doesn’t feel too heavy on my face. It gives a subtle tone up effect without making my tan skin look like I smeared toothpaste all over my face. It’s gentle enough that it can be used on a compromised skin barrier and also has soothing ingredients that will calm irritated skin.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款礦物防曬，你都會鍾意嘅，原因如下。佢係我至今試過唯一一款用上面唔會覺得太厚重嘅礦物防曬。佢有輕微提亮效果，但唔會令我曬黑嘅皮膚望落好似塗咗成面牙膏咁。佢夠溫和，可以喺皮膚屏障受損嘅時候使用，仲有舒緩成分可以鎮靜受刺激嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Truecica Natural Calming Tone-Up Suncream 50ml
reviews.text: El protector solar es muy suave con la piel no irrita y a pesar ser mineral no esté pesado como otros productos anteriormente probados.
reviews.zh: 呢款防曬對皮膚好溫和，唔會刺激，雖然係礦物防曬但用落唔似之前試過嘅其他產品咁厚重。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Truecica Natural Calming Tone-Up Suncream 50ml
reviews.text: It spreads well and I was personally satisfied.
reviews.zh: 容易推開，我自己都好滿意。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Truecica Natural Calming Tone-Up Suncream 50ml
reviews.text:
Very love it. It’s my second purchase.

reviews.zh:
超級鍾意，已經係第二次回購。
令我皮膚提亮，仲有粉嫩嘅光澤感。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Truecica Natural Calming Tone-Up Suncream 50ml
reviews.text: Good sunscreen. Leaves white cast in beginning, but disappears soon.
reviews.zh: 好嘅防曬。一開始會泛白，但好快就消退。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Truecica Natural Calming Tone-Up Suncream 50ml
reviews.text: Formula wise, it leans much more toward your traditional beach sunscreen texture. Will leave a white cast with a particularly heavy application, but it absolutely does what it says on the tin. Heads up, it will cling to dry patches.
reviews.zh: 配方嚟講，比較偏向傳統沙灘防曬嘅質地。如果搽得特別厚會泛白，但確實做到包裝上所講嘅效果。提一提，佢會黏住乾燥位置。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Truecica Natural Calming Tone-Up Suncream 50ml
reviews.text: It’s a good sunscreen! Better for the body, in my opinion. A little too thick for the face. But really good coverage.
reviews.zh: 係一款好嘅防曬！以我嘅意見，用喺身體比較好。用上面有少少太厚，但防曬力真係好強。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Truecica Natural Calming Tone-Up Suncream 50ml
reviews.text: I love this! My kids also stole it and used it and enjoyed it. It didn't leave a cast
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意！我啲細路都偷咗去用，仲用得好開心。冇泛白。
